result.brief: 提出 Beckmann 世界模型，用终端映射守恒律直接从噪声、视觉历史与动作一步预测未来帧，并加入端点对齐训练与潜空间特征监督，提升动作条件视频预测效率与精度。
result.reason: Action-conditioned video world model with one-step prediction and latent-space feature supervision; contributes a direct noise-to-frame map and representation-level training, not just an encoder baseline.
